title: WikiArticleDraftRequest
description: wiki.article-draft-request@1: the body of the wiki writer on OpenVibe.Wiki (an editor of the space). POST /api/v1/pages/:id/draft runs OpenVibe.AI's content.wiki workflow — research with web search plus the sources the article already cites, a citation on every sentence, and an infobox from structured facts — and files the result as a pending wiki proposal. It never publishes: a person approves it in the review queue.

instruction.description: What the editor wants written or improved.

choice.description: The model for the writer, from the same chip as every AI run.
